mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_rentals (user_id, equipment_id, rent_date, expected_return_date, requested_quantity, purpose, status, is_approved, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{equipmentId}, #{rentDate}, #{expectedReturnDate}, #{requestedQuantity}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{isApproved}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, rejection_reason AS rejectionReason FROM equipment_rentals WHERE is_approved = FALSE AND status NOT IN ('RETURNED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_rentals SET is_approved = TRUE, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE equipment_rentals SET return_date = #{returnDate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE equipment_rentals SET status = #{status}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND return_date IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_rentals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND return_date IS NULL AND is_approved = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_rentals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND return_date IS NULL AND expected_return_date < NOW() AND is_approved = TRUE

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rent_date AS rentDate, expected_return_date AS expectedReturnDate, return_date AS returnDate, extension_count AS extensionCount, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity, purpose, is_approved AS isApproved, approved_by AS approvedBy, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM equipment_rentals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND return_date IS NULL AND is_approved = TRUE AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'RENTED') ORDER BY rent_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_rentals SET status = 'REJECTED', is_approved = FALSE, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
